metaTitle: Roofing Marketing Agency for Roofing Contractors
metaDescription: Roofing marketing built around storm-driven demand: search, Local Services Ads, StormFront content and tracking that ties leads to booked jobs.
intro: ASP is a roofing marketing agency for contractors who want more inspection, repair and replacement work. We run Google search, Local Services Ads, Meta and StormFront weather-triggered content as one system. Every channel is measured against booked jobs, not clicks.

sections.heading: How demand for roofing work rises and falls
paragraphs: The Bureau of Labor Statistics names roof replacement, roof repair and new roof installation as what will create demand for roofers, and says some of it may come from rooftop solar panel installs. A homeowner pricing a full replacement and a homeowner with a drip in the ceiling are different buyers, so they need different pages, ads and follow-up.

The calendar matters too. BLS notes that roofing work may be limited during winter in northern states, that roofers may work overtime in the busy summer months, and that crews usually do not work in bad weather. Your marketing should push hardest when your crews can get on roofs, and use the slower months to line up inspections and planned replacements.

Storms add sudden spikes on top of the season. NOAA says hail can damage homes, and that the area where Nebraska, Colorado and Wyoming meet averages seven to nine hail days a year. In guidance published in 2013, the National Roofing Contractors Association suggested extra roof inspections after severe weather such as a hurricane, tornado or hailstorm.

sections.heading: Marketing channels ASP runs for roofing contractors
paragraphs: BLS counted 26,626 private residential roofing contractor establishments in the US in 2025. We run the channels below as one system, and each one has its own job.
The order depends on where you are today. If high-intent searches are going unanswered, search and Local Services Ads come first. Meta is built around them.
bullets: Google Search Ads: for the homeowner searching for a leak repair or a replacement quote right now.
Local Services Ads: in the US, Google lists roofers as a Local Services Ads category, and advertisers who pass Google's screening and verification pay for leads instead of clicks.
Local SEO and service pages: map-pack visibility plus a page for each roofing service with real search demand.
StormFront: weather-triggered content for your service area, built for storm-driven demand.
Meta: finished-roof photos and video for replacement buyers who decide over weeks, plus campaigns to recruit crew.

sections.heading: StormFront: weather-triggered content for roofers
paragraphs: StormFront is ASP's own content system for weather-driven operators. It watches your service area for qualifying weather events, such as storms. When one hits, it publishes location-aware, service-relevant posts to your blog, Google Business Profile and social profiles, timed to the spike in search.

Each post comes from a library our specialists write in your brand voice, and is matched and localized to your area when a trigger fires. Each one carries a call to action that fits the event, like a roof inspection after hail, and form submissions route into Housecall Pro with source attribution. A monthly trigger report shows what fired, what published and what converted, tied to attributed revenue in Housecall Pro.
StormFront runs on its own for $549 a month. It is also part of the Foundation package at $2,500 a month, alongside Local SEO Pro, the Content Creation Package and Housecall Pro attribution setup.

sections.heading: How we measure roofing marketing results
paragraphs: Calls and form fills are where measurement starts, not where it ends. A repair lead and a replacement lead can be worth very different amounts, so a report that only counts leads hides which channel is paying for itself. Where your CRM supports it, we follow each lead to the booked job and the revenue it produced.

Where your CRM supports it, lead source is carried through to the job record. For roofers on Housecall Pro, Foundation includes attribution setup. Where Google Ads is running, booked revenue in Housecall Pro can be sent back to Google Ads as an offline conversion so bidding works toward jobs instead of raw leads. ASP is an Official Housecall Pro Affiliate Partner.
Each month you see what was spent, what it booked and what changes next.

sections.heading: What you own
paragraphs: Everything we build for your roofing company is set up in your name. That includes the domain and website, your Google Business Profile and its reviews, and your Google Ads, Meta and Local Services Ads accounts. Ad spend is paid straight to the platforms from your own accounts and is not part of any ASP fee.
Your CRM data and customer records stay yours, and ASP does not charge handover or exit fees to transfer what was built for you. The full list is on our What You Own page.

faqs.question: What does a roofing marketing agency do?
faqs.answer: It brings in calls and form fills from homeowners who need roof work, then shows which of those turned into booked jobs. At ASP that means search, Local Services Ads, local SEO, Meta and StormFront content run as one system. Where your CRM supports attribution, each channel is reported against booked revenue, not clicks.

faqs.question: Is StormFront only for roofers in hail country?
faqs.answer: No. StormFront's watchlist covers storm events, extreme temperatures, seasonal indicators and drought or flood cycles. It is monitored across your own service area, so it fires when qualifying weather hits your market.

faqs.question: Do you only market storm-damage roofing?
faqs.answer: No. Storm work is one part of roofing demand. Replacement, repair, inspection and new installation each get their own page and ad group where there is real search demand, and StormFront handles the weather-driven spikes on top.

faqs.question: How much does roofing marketing cost with ASP?
faqs.answer: Foundation is $2,500 a month. Growth, which adds paid media management for Google Ads, Meta and Local Services Ads, is $3,850 a month, and StormFront is available on its own for $549 a month. Ad spend is separate and paid directly to the platforms. Full details are on our pricing page.

faqs.question: Can you tell me which marketing channel produced each roofing job?
faqs.answer: Where your CRM supports attribution, yes. Lead source is carried from the first call or form through to the booked job, so you can compare channels on revenue. For Housecall Pro users, attribution setup is part of Foundation.

faqs.question: Do I keep my website and ad accounts if I leave?
faqs.answer: Yes, under ASP's terms, unless your Scope of Work states otherwise. They are set up in your name from day one, and ASP does not charge exit fees to transfer what was built for you. Our What You Own page lists every asset.
